mapper.sql: SELECT n.note_id, o.user_id, n.file_id, n.note_title AS title, f.file_name, p.svg_data AS strokes_json FROM user_note n INNER JOIN user_note_owner o ON o.note_id = n.note_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN user_files f ON f.file_id = n.file_id AND f.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN note_page_info p ON p.note_id = n.note_id AND p.page = 1
mapper.select: WHERE u.username = #{username} ORDER BY n.note_id DESC

SELECT p.svg_data FROM note_page_info p INNER JOIN user_note_owner o ON o.note_id = p.note_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND p.note_id = #{noteId} AND p.page = #{pageNumber} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_page_info (note_id, page, svg_data) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{pageNumber}, #{strokesJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE svg_data = VALUES(svg_data)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(p.page), 1) FROM note_page_info p INNER JOIN user_note_owner o ON o.note_id = p.note_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND p.note_id = #{noteId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_page_info (note_id, page, svg_data) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{pageNumber}, '[]')
mapper.delete: DELETE n FROM user_note n INNER JOIN user_note_owner o ON o.note_id = n.note_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND n.note_id = #{noteId}
